title: HOLD-LC-001 public GTS code-level response and likelihood owner candidate
question: Does a public, commit-pinned GBM Targeted Search implementation provide a reproducible finite response/LLR code path that can advance HOLD-LC-001 owner intake without being promoted to the Stachie joint statistic or a continuous physical timing owner?
method: Resolve the public USRA-STI/gamma-ray-targeted-search main ref to an exact commit hash and inspect its README, likelihood, response, search, configuration and prior modules plus the GW170817 example locator.

Extract code semantics for counts/background/response likelihood, source-amplitude marginalization, time-bin construction, spacecraft-frame midpoint evaluation, atmospheric response interpolation, Earth masking and sky-prior normalization.

Crosswalk the code-level objects against the existing Stachie finite Lambda candidate and the hash-pinned HOLD-LC-001 estimator/response-owner contracts, distinguishing GBM finite implementation from joint association and continuous detector timing.
Define a reproduction packet and run adversarial separation checks; preserve T-054/T-059 methods, owner order and stopped-loop rules, and do not execute an event score or prospective test.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Public code semantics and reproduction prerequisites for a finite GBM counts/background/response likelihood only; no event execution, no joint association FAR reproduction, no continuous timing likelihood, no covariance and no prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 P1 source-owner intake refinement; T-054 forward method, T-059 inverse method, owner order and stopped-loop rules remain unchanged.

official_code_source.license: Apache-2.0 as displayed by the repository

outputs: marginalized finite log-likelihood ratio over spectral templates and sky locations
choices: power-law source-amplitude prior gamma=2.5 by default
nonnegative background clipping and response-weighted variance
coinclr combines a supplied sky prior with the log-likelihood

search_and_configuration.time_bins: Durations are 1.024 * 2**k over the configured range; steps are max(min_step, duration/num_steps); binned data are aligned to time edges.
search_and_configuration.outputs: Each time bin records start, duration, best sky position, fit status, optimal SNR, best template, photon flux, chi-square diagnostics and marginalized LLR.

response.time_rule: preprocess evaluates spacecraft frames and geocentric coordinates at response-bin midpoints and caches load points.
response.matrix_rule: The code assumes a constant response over a short-burst period, combines direct and atmospheric components and linearly weights nearest atmospheric azimuth templates.
response.visibility_rule: Earth-occultation masks are generated from loaded geocentric coordinates.

sky_prior_and_example.sky_prior: Uniform prior without a map; otherwise HEALPix density is mapped to the spacecraft frame and normalized.
sky_prior_and_example.example: README supplies a GW170817 example requiring external GBM TTE/trigdat files, detector templates and Gamma-ray Data Tools.

partial_fields_supported: Finite GBM response/LLR implementation candidate with explicit code entrypoint.
Finite time-bin, midpoint-frame and short-burst constant-response semantics.
Direct plus atmospheric response and Earth-mask code path.
Uniform or HEALPix sky-prior path and finite result schema.
Version-pinned public source repository and an event reproduction recipe.
not_supported_for_hold_lc_001_admission: Immutable event TTE/CSPEC/PHA/position-history/trigdat and response-template bytes.
Exact dependency lock, template archive hash and event-specific response validity/interpolation.
Stachie Q_L/Q_G population calibration and joint Lambda background FAR implementation.
Detector-to-geocenter conversion, Earth-orientation convention and timing uncertainty.
GW merger-time likelihood, joint covariance and intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law.
F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, candidate score or prospective holdout.

checks.detail: git ls-remote resolves refs/heads/main to 1bc1e913f97fd7195a7e297f8d6032a5c7758894 on 2026-08-30.
The inspected modules expose finite likelihood, search-bin, response-midpoint, atmospheric interpolation, Earth-mask and sky-prior paths.
A public code path and GW170817 recipe exist, but event/template bytes, dependency versions, joint-ranking linkage and physical timing uncertainty are not frozen.
The result is an additive T-061 source candidate; T-054/T-059 methods, owner order and stopped-loop registry are unchanged.

finding: The public GTS repository supplies an inspectable finite GBM implementation candidate. Likelihood.calculate accepts counts, background, variance and response arrays; response.py evaluates spacecraft-frame and geocentric coordinates at time-bin midpoints, combines direct and atmospheric response templates under a short-burst constant-response assumption, and creates Earth masks; search.py and configuration.py define time bins and finite outputs; priors.py defines uniform or HEALPix sky priors; the README gives a GW170817 example and external input requirements. This materially narrows the reproduction route but does not admit HOLD-LC-001: event/template bytes, dependency lock, response validity, detector-to-geocenter conversion, covariance, the Stachie joint Lambda path and prospective lock remain absent.
decision_reason: This is a new commit-pinned public implementation with concrete finite estimator and response code, not another literature summary. It creates a reproducible synthetic-first intake packet while preserving the existing proof methods and all physical/prospective firewalls.
decision_scope: T0 public finite GBM code-owner crosswalk and reproduction checklist only; no event result, continuous timing, physical identity or empirical prediction.
assumptions: The repository commit hash recorded on 2026-08-30 is the intended public GTS edition for this intake.
The inspected file paths at that commit expose the code semantics recorded here until a new commit is pinned.
Repository defaults and short-burst assumptions are implementation choices and require separate physical-owner acceptance.
The local HOLD-LC-001 estimator and response-owner contracts remain controlling for timing, calibration and covariance admission.
missing_assumptions: Immutable event data and response-template bytes with hashes, plus exact dependency/environment versions.
A source-owned linkage from GTS finite GBM LLR to the Stachie Q_G and joint Lambda implementation.
Event-specific response validity/interpolation, gain calibration and detector-to-geocenter conversion with uncertainty.
A common timing covariance, intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law and sealed prospective holdout.
Independent primary/secondary/hostile reproduction on a frozen synthetic fixture before event use.

adversarial_review.check: Does a public code repository automatically provide the physical owner required by HOLD-LC-001?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: public code does not freeze event inputs, calibration validity, propagation uncertainty or source ownership.

adversarial_review.check: Can the GTS GBM LLR be treated as the complete Stachie joint Lambda?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the code exposes the GBM likelihood path but not the full Q_L/Q_G population calibration and joint background FAR path.

adversarial_review.check: Can midpoint spacecraft-frame response generation be treated as detector-to-geocenter correction?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: response evaluation and Earth masking are not a detector-to-geocenter propagation algorithm or uncertainty budget.

adversarial_review.check: Can repository defaults be used as preregistered event calibration or candidate-score values?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: defaults require event/template/dependency version freeze before residual inspection.

adversarial_review.check: Could GTS replace the established T-054 forward or T-059 inverse method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive T-061 finite owner candidate and leaves both methods unchanged.

boundary: EXP-001312 is a T0 public code-level finite GBM crosswalk. It does not admit a continuous HOLD-LC-001 likelihood, covariance, detector-to-geocenter implementation, response value, calibration-validity rule, intrinsic-lag nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 public source-code inspection with commit pin and synthetic-first reproduction plan; no event execution or numerical reproduction

freeze_before_event_use: all source file hashes and repository commit
Gamma-ray Data Tools and numerical dependency versions
detector/channel configuration, background fit and time-bin settings
response midpoint/atmospheric interpolation and Earth-mask choices
test_order: independent implementation or parser of finite LLR, response indexing and sky-prior normalization
hostile mutations of source/template/data hashes and boundary settings
only then event-level reproduction, still retrospective and non-prospective

next_action: Freeze the pinned GTS commit, dependency lock, response-template archive and exact GW170817 inputs; execute the synthetic primary/independent/hostile finite LLR and response-index reproduction before touching event data. Keep Stachie joint-ranking completion, detector-to-geocenter conversion, covariance, intrinsic-lag scoring and prospective credit locked, and continue unchanged T-054 owner intake in parallel.
stop_or_redesign: If the repository commit, templates or event inputs cannot be version-pinned, retain the code as public provenance and do not admit HOLD-LC-001.
If GTS finite LLR cannot be linked to the Stachie Q_G and joint Lambda path without post hoc choices, keep the two owner candidates separate.
If response midpoint/interpolation or Earth-mask choices change with candidate labels, invalidate the reproduction and issue a new versioned packet.
If continuous timing/covariance and a prospective lock remain absent, report finite GBM code evidence only.
non_claims: The public GTS code is not an admitted continuous Delta_t_det likelihood, detector-to-geocenter correction or covariance.
The finite GBM LLR and response path are not the complete Stachie joint Lambda or a prospective scorer.
No event result, response value, candidate map, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, prospective prediction or microscopic forward map is admitted.
No QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity identity, Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim follows.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, owner order and stopped-loop rules are unchanged.
